name: ipp-skills
description: A growing collection of Claude Code skills for understanding code and concepts deeply, learning faster, and doing better research.

plugins.name: understanding
plugins.description: Skills that turn dense code and concepts into structured, navigable explanations — interactive box-diagrams of code, semantic structure-aware diffs, and annotated line-by-line traces of your own source. For when you want to understand, not just read.

plugins.name: sw-eng
plugins.description: Everyday software-engineering skills: the passes you run on real code before it ships — starting with comments and docstrings that read as finished documentation rather than a transcript of how the code got written.
